::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [August 1866]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS University of Iowa; MsL/Y56wa
:::

My dear [Mrs Warburton](people/person_1465.qmd), 
I am sorry to say I have to dine with a great wedding party on Monday at my [brother](people/person_1624.qmd)’s, as [Miss Walter](people/person_616.qmd)’s wedding is to be on Tuesday, so that I am obliged to miss the pleasure you kindly propose to me

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Louisa Walter married  Francis Edward Halliday in Otterbourne on Tuesday 7 August 1866.
